title: TimeLimit
description: A configuable daily time limit mod. Available for FabricMC.
body:
**REQUIRES: [Fabric Api](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)**

# TimeLimit

Allows you to set a daily time limit.

# Usage

All configuration is handled inside config/TimeLimit/TimeLimit.json

- `"timezone_offset"` allows you to set the timezone offset, format: `"(+/-)HH:MM"` or `"(+/-)HH:MM:SS"`. Defaults to: `Z` (UTC)
- `"disconnect_message"` is the message that is shown when the user disconnects, due to playing to much. Defaults to: `§cYou have reached your daily time limit.`
- `"allowed_time"` is the daily allowed time in seconds. Defaults to: `7200` (2h)
